**DK26.0** is a specific medical diagnosis code within the ICD-10-DK classification system that designates "acute duodenal ulcer with hemorrhage" (*akut duodenalulcus med blødning*) [^src1]. In the context of the Danish healthcare system, this code is utilized by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) to monitor patient safety and treatment outcomes.

Specifically, DK26.0 is a critical component in the clinical quality indicators for patients with [[atrieflimren]] [^src1]. Because treatments for atrial fibrillation often involve anticoagulant medications, patients are at an elevated risk for bleeding complications. To measure the incidence of severe bleeding events in this population, the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database tracks a comprehensive list of diagnostic codes [^src1]. DK26.0 is categorized under gastrointestinal bleeding, alongside other related codes such as [[dk25-0|DK25.0]], [[dk27-0|DK27.0]], and [[dk92-0|DK92.0]] [^src1]. This systematic tracking allows healthcare authorities to evaluate the safety of anticoagulant therapies and compare clinical quality across different Danish regions [^src2]. The code's definition and application are consistently documented in the annual methodology reports for atrial fibrillation, including both the 2023 and 2024 publications [^src1] [^src2].
